topic: How are link budgets affected when prioritizing high-revenue services versus navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling?
consensus_response: Prioritizing high-revenue services over navigation safety margins in dynamic scheduling affects link budgets by reducing resources for navigation, increasing susceptibility to interference and atmospheric conditions. Beamforming and adaptive antennas enhance resource utilization but require careful management to balance revenue and safety priorities.
reference_context: QoS provisioning in satellite networks involves managing capacity, latency, and jitter to ensure reliable communication.
